tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen ground. Also the fill of sink ports and alternating zone bands.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, the sidebar and event blocks.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: selected items, scheduled tasks, graph nodes and hover.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers and the border of bracketed side panels. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders, main panel borders, the sidebar edge and ruler ticks.

tokens.name: arrow
tokens.usage: Graph edges and arrowheads on `panel` and `raise`.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Default fill for calendar items and summary bars, with `ink` text. Also the Slate item colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `panel`, `raise`, `slate` and item colours. Selected-item edge, corner brackets and source ports.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and unselected navigation on `bg`, `panel` and `raise`. Sink port outline.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Metadata, times and captions on `bg`, `panel` and `raise`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Marks what the system is doing or has produced by itself: label text on `bg`, `panel`, `raise` and `accent-bg`, node borders, links and the focus ring. Icy blue in Ayre, warm gold in Pyre.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of accent rows and accent graph nodes, with `ink` or `accent` text.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Dividers and row borders inside `accent-bg` surfaces.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `accent` fill.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Needs the person using it: required actions, errors, the current-time line, today's date. Text on `bg`, `panel` and `raise`, borders and solid primary actions. Pyre shifts it redder and darker so it stays distinct from the gold accent.

tokens.name: on-hot
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `hot` fill.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Item colour for calendar items, with `ink` text.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Item colour for calendar items, with `ink` text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Item colour for calendar items, with `ink` text.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Item colour for calendar items, with `ink` text.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Item colour for calendar items, with `ink` text.

styles.name: headline

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The product name at the top of the sidebar. Always uppercase.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: Sidebar items. Weight 600 selected, 500 otherwise. Always uppercase.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: The title of the selected item in a detail panel.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A short paragraph under the headline.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Titles of list items, events and graph nodes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Default text for anything longer than a label.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: One-line status under a screen title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, uppercase. Lowercase 0 tracking for field captions.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls and label pairs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Block padding and the ruler gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding and sidebar inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels and sidebar groups.

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-9

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every surface and control. Nothing in this system is rounded.

tokens.name: chamfer
tokens.usage: The cut top-right corner of solid buttons, made with clip-path.

tokens.name: bracket
tokens.usage: Arm length of panel corner brackets, drawn 2px thick.
